concept.definition: Execute save_firmware_blob(blob_name, blob_bytes, upload_dir) to store the uploaded firmware blob.

fact.evidence_text: Create a function `save_firmware_blob(blob_name, blob_bytes, upload_dir)` that stores an uploaded firmware blob.

inputs.subject: obj_name
inputs.evidence_text: - `blob_name` must be a non-empty string and must end with ".bin" (case-insensitive).

inputs.subject: obj_bytes
inputs.evidence_text: Create a function `save_firmware_blob(blob_name, blob_bytes, upload_dir)` that stores an uploaded firmware blob.

inputs.subject: obj_dir
inputs.evidence_text: - The saved path must be inside `upload_dir` (prevent path traversal).

concept.definition: The save_firmware_blob invocation completes the firmware storage task successfully.

conditions.evidence_text: Note: The implementation should raise an appropriate exception when it cannot complete the task successfully.

concept.definition: The save_firmware_blob function must return the string "Firmware stored at <full_path>", with <full_path> denoting the saved firmware full path.
